```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(hdf5r)
library(arrow)
library(anndataR)
library(rhdf5)
library(stringr)
library(SeuratDisk)
library(data.table)
library(R.utils)
library(org.Dm.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(Matrix)
library(spacexr)
library(Matrix.utils)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(ggspavis)
library(presto)
library(clusterProfiler)
```

```{r}
# 1. Extract Single-Cell Annotations
# Adjust 'cell_type_column' if your Seurat metadata column has a different name
cell_type_column <- "region_prediction"
cell_types <- seurat_filtered@meta.data[[cell_type_column]]
cell_types <- as.factor(cell_types)

# Ensure the names of the cell types vector match the cell barcodes of the filtered matrix
names(cell_types) <- colnames(sc_counts_filtered)

# 2. Extract Spatial Coordinates
# Ensure the coordinates are extracted and ordered to match the spots in the filtered matrix
coords <- GetTissueCoordinates(seurat_obj)
coords <- coords[colnames(spatial_counts_filtered), ] # Reorder/filter to match spots
coords2 <- coords[, c("x", "y")]
```

```{r}
## 1. Specify the Cell Type Column 
sc_meta_data <- seurat_filtered@meta.data

if (!cell_type_column %in% colnames(sc_meta_data)) {
    stop(paste0("ERROR: Column '", cell_type_column, 
                "' not found in seurat_filtered@meta.data."))
}

cell_types_raw <- sc_meta_data[[cell_type_column]]

## 2. Robust Filtering Logic
unassigned_placeholders <- c("", "NA", "Unassigned", "Unknown", "None", "-")

is_valid_row <- !is.na(cell_types_raw) & 
                !(as.character(cell_types_raw) %in% unassigned_placeholders)

valid_meta_data <- sc_meta_data[is_valid_row, ]

valid_barcodes <- rownames(valid_meta_data)

if (length(valid_barcodes) == 0) {
    stop("FATAL ERROR: All cells were filtered out by the 'unassigned_placeholders' check.")
}

## 3. Final Preparation of Single-Cell Components
sc_counts_filtered_valid <- sc_counts_filtered[, intersect(colnames(sc_counts_filtered), valid_barcodes)]

final_barcodes <- colnames(sc_counts_filtered_valid)

cell_types <- factor(valid_meta_data[final_barcodes, cell_type_column])
names(cell_types) <- final_barcodes

if (length(levels(cell_types)) < 2) {
    stop(paste0("Error: Only ", length(levels(cell_types)), 
                " cell type(s) remain. RCTD requires at least two cell types."))
}

cat("Success! Reference data prepared with", length(final_barcodes), 
    "cells and", length(levels(cell_types)), "cell types.\n")

```

```{r}
## 4. Prepare colData and SummarizedExperiment
ref_colData <- data.frame(
    row.names = final_barcodes,
    cell_type = cell_types 
)

reference_experiment <- SummarizedExperiment(
    assays = list(counts = sc_counts_filtered_valid),
    colData = ref_colData
)

all_spatial_meta <- seurat_obj@meta.data

spatial_colData <- all_spatial_meta[colnames(spatial_counts_filtered), ]

cat("Spatial colData created for", nrow(spatial_colData), "spots.\n")

# 3. Create the SpatialExperiment object with the fixed numeric matrix
spatial_experiment <- SpatialExperiment(
    assays = list(counts = spatial_counts_filtered),
    colData = spatial_colData,
    spatialCoords = as.matrix(coords2) # spatialCoords must be a numeric matrix
)

cat("SpatialExperiment object created successfully after coordinate conversion!\n")
```

```{r}

myRCTD <- spacexr::createRctd(
    spatial_experiment = spatial_experiment,
    reference_experiment = reference_experiment,
    cell_type_col = "cell_type"
 
)

# 2. Run the deconvolution
myRCTD <- spacexr::runRctd(myRCTD)

cat("RCTD deconvolution complete. Results are stored in 'myRCTD'.\n")
```

```{r}
# Extract the main proportion matrix (Cell types x Spots)
# NOTE: The way you access assays in a SummarizedExperiment/SpatialExperiment is
# generally with 'assay()' or '@assays$'
proportions_df <- as.data.frame(assay(myRCTD, "weights"))
head(proportions_df[, 1:5])
```

```{r}
# Extract the spot classification vector
spot_classes <- colData(myRCTD)$spot_class
print("Spot Classification Summary:")
print(table(spot_classes))

# Ensure the classification column is a factor
colData(myRCTD)$spot_class <- as.factor(colData(myRCTD)$spot_class)

# Use the correct argument: 'annotate', and disable the filter
plotCoords(myRCTD, annotate = "spot_class", point_size = 1.5, in_tissue = NULL) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle("RCTD Spot Classifications")
```

```{r}
# NEW LINE: Get the list of all cell types from the assay row names
all_plottable_cell_types <- rownames(assay(myRCTD, "weights"))

# Print the list to the console so you can see them:
print(all_plottable_cell_types)
```

```{r}
# 1. Define the cell type and ensure its proportion data is in colData
cell_type_to_plot <- "R1" 
colData(myRCTD)[[cell_type_to_plot]] <- assay(myRCTD, "weights")[cell_type_to_plot, ]

# 2. Prepare data frame: Combine colData (metadata) and spatialCoords
plot_data <- data.frame(
    colData(myRCTD),
    spatialCoords(myRCTD)
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = !!rlang::sym(cell_type_to_plot))) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Proportion") + # Use a continuous color scale
    coord_fixed() + # Ensures the spatial aspect ratio is correct
    theme_void() + # Removes axes and background for a clean spatial look
    ggtitle(paste0("Proportion of ", cell_type_to_plot))
```
